leave.question: Write a 2-line leave message to my manager. I have fever today and will be back tomorrow.
leave.reply:
Dear Manager,
I am sorry to inform you that I have a fever today and will be back to work tomorrow.
Thank you for your understanding.

emi.question: Explain what a loan EMI is, in 3 simple lines, for a college student.
emi.reply: An EMI stands for Equated Monthly Installment, which is the monthly payment made towards a loan. It includes the principal amount borrowed and the interest charged. For a college student, EMI helps in managing financial obligations, especially for loans like student loans or personal loans.
